"Revise the following (on “moved upon” of Genesis 1:2):\n\nmoved upon] The rendering of the RV margin, was brooding upon, furnishes the picture of a bird spreading its wings over its nest; it also reproduces the meaning of the participle of the Hebrew verb, which implies continuousness in the action. For the use of the same unusual Hebrew word, cf. Deuteronomy 32:11. By the selection of this word the writer conveys the thought that the continuous, fostering care of the Almighty was given to the welter of primaeval chaos no less than to the orderly successive phenomena of the universe. It may, indeed, be questioned whether, if the word is intended to denote the action of a bird, it should not be rendered “was fluttering,” or “was hovering,” rather than “was brooding.” Motion seems to be implied: and the simile is not so much that of a bird sitting upon its nest as that of a bird hovering with outstretched wings over the young ones in the nest. The choice of the word, with its allusion to bird life, has been thought to be a polemical reference to primitive mythologies, e.g. Greek, Phoenician, Egyptian, according to which the universe or a primaeval deity was hatched out of the “cosmic egg.”", "vector": [-0.025579354871929468, 0.04042817900658188, -0.008474495001778675, -0.018376444833660393, 0.004585907653768409, -0.023938601101754713, Something peculiar had caught her attention—a mud volcano known as Mubbly Bubbly. To the untrained eye, it looked like any other mud volcano—an inconspicuous mound gently bubbling with muddy ooze. However, Miss Henderson had a special gift for noticing subtleties in nature.\n\nUpon closer inspection, she noticed a seemingly out-of-place glow emanating from Mubbly Bubbly’s core. Intrigued, she felt a connection to this mysterious feature of the park. With great care and tenderness, Miss Henderson placed a small communication device on top of the volcano. This ingenious contraption allowed her to listen to the thoughts of Mubbly Bubbly, revealing an unprecedented miracle—a sentient mud volcano.\n\nAs Miss Henderson listened to Mubbly Bubbly’s thoughts, she discovered a profound loneliness within the mud volcano’s primordial existence. Isolated for ages, Mubbly Bubbly had been yearning for companionship, for someone who would care for it and understand its sentient nature.\n\nWithout hesitation, Miss Henderson made it her mission to fill Mubbly Bubbly’s life with care and tenderness. She visited the mud volcano daily, sharing stories of the park’s inhabitants, the healing power of nature, and their captivating adventures. The once-lonely mud volcano flourished under the gentle care and understanding that Miss Henderson offered. Its muddy surface sparkled with newfound life, attracting a mosaic of vibrant flora and fauna.\n\nNews of Mubbly Bubbly’s transformation spread throughout the park, attracting curious park visitors from far and wide. They organized educational tours, spreading awareness about the awe-inspiring wonders of the park and the importance of preserving its delicate ecosystem. With Mubbly Bubbly as a symbol of rejuvenation and the power of nurturing, the park flourished under their joint efforts.\n\nYears passed, and Miss Henderson and Mubbly Bubbly’s bond grew stronger each day. More and more people began to cherish the fragile balance of the natural world, embracing the responsibility to protect and nurture it.\n\nAs the final chapter of their story was written, a plaque was erected near Mubbly Bubbly, commemorating the power of love and understanding. Miss Henderson taught us that even in the unlikeliest of places, profound connections can blossom. It was a reminder to cherish the world around us and the magical possibilities that lie hidden beneath the surface, waiting to be discovered.While Miss Henderson had formed an extraordinary bond with Mubbly Bubbly, she had always wondered if there was more to their relationship. She carefully brought a small piece of cheese from her packed lunch and gently placed it on Mubbly Bubbly’s surface.\n\nTo her surprise, the sentient mud volcano began to absorb the cheese. Its muddy body rippled and quivered with excitement as the cheese vanished within its form. Miss Henderson watched in awe as Mubbly Bubbly’s vibrant colors intensified, reflecting a new energy.\n\nAs Mubbly Bubbly absorbed the cheese, it began to churn and bubble with even greater enthusiasm. The liquid mud swirled and twirled, creating magnificent patterns that mesmerized Miss Henderson. But as quickly as the cheese had disappeared, Mubbly Bubbly excreted it back out, spitting it out with a playful splatter.\n\nThe park worker burst into laughter, thoroughly entertained by Mubbly Bubbly’s unexpected reaction. She couldn’t help but feel a sense of joy in the simplicity of the moment. It was a reminder that even in the presence of something otherworldly, the simplest gestures could bring immense delight.\n\nWith a sparkle in her eyes, Miss Henderson realized that the cheese had brought a momentary change to Mubbly Bubbly’s usual routine. It was a reminder of the uniqueness and fluidity of their bond. She understood that her friendship with the sentient mud volcano was something beyond comprehension—a connection unlike any other.\n\nAs the day came to a close and the sun dipped below the horizon, Miss Henderson instinctively began to sing a lullaby she often hummed when she needed solace. The soothing melody floated through the air and gently caressed Mubbly Bubbly’s spirit.\n\nIn response, the mud volcano emitted a harmonious vibration, complementing Miss Henderson’s tune. It was as if Mubbly Bubbly was singing along, expressing its appreciation for her care and friendship. The serene symphony blended with the rustling leaves and the distant whispers of nature, creating a moment of pure magic.\n\nWith a sense of contentment and fulfillment, Miss Henderson bid Mubbly Bubbly goodnight. The mud volcano’s surface settled into a peaceful stillness, disclosing its trust and gratitude. As she left the park, Miss Henderson marveled at the profound connection she had established with a sentient mud volcano.\n\nFrom that day forward, as Miss Henderson continued to care for Mubbly Bubbly and the national park, visitors could often hear her soothing lullabies echo through the trees. These harmonies carried the essence of her bond with Mubbly Bubbly and acted as a reminder to cherish the extraordinary relationships that exist within the natural world.\n\nIn the end, Miss Henderson’s story served as a reminder to all who heard it—that profound connections could be found in even the unlikeliest places. And in those connections, lay the power to transform lives, inspire change, and create a deeper appreciation for the world we inhabit.
